senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; צָרַר II , v. צָרַד) pebble, stone.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:6">Sabb. VIII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 81a:1">81ᵃ</cite>) <he>צ׳ או אבן</he>, read as in Y. ed. <he>צ׳ אבן</he> a pebble; Tosef. ib. VIII (IX), 22; Y. ib. VIII, 11ᶜ top (v. Rabb. D. S. to Sabb. l. c. note 3).
<cite ref="Gittin 64b:9">Gitt. 64ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>צ׳ וזורקו אגוז וכ׳</he> a child that is given a pebble and throws it away, a nut and takes it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 1:2">Men. I, 2</cite> <he>קמץ ועלה בידו צ׳</he> if the priest took a handful (of the meal offering), and a pebble was in it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 1:4">T’bul Yom I, 4</cite> <he>הצ׳ שבככר</he> a pebble (or a piece of earthen ware) put as a mark on a loaf; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צְרוֹרוֹת</he>. Y. Erub. V, 22ᶜ top.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:1:2">Y. Yoma IV, beg. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>ויביא שני צ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>צרורת</he>) let him take two pebbles, one black &c.; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 587:3">Yalk. Lev. 587</cite> <he>נפלו ממנו צ׳</he>, read: <he>נִיצוֹצוֹת</he>.]
